short: The controls' looks, one stylesheet per family
is: Seven family stylesheets ported from the design system's bundle onto tokens: button, field, check, toggle, tabs, menu and tip. The styles entry imports each.
conventions: A look is the bundle's `zf-` class name, composed with the paper classes (`placed`, `pick`, `piece`, `slip`, `lift`, `glidex`) rather than rewriting their lifts and glides: primary, secondary and destructive buttons are placed; quiet buttons and plain icon buttons are picks; fields are slips, and Select's slip lifts while it can be changed; tabs and the switch are one piece with pick options; the menu and the select's list are a note whose rows are picks; the toggle's thumb is placed and glides.

Everything comes from tokens: no raw colour, time, easing or length, except `0`, 1px borders, the 2px focus ring, percentages and unitless numbers. A size the bundle writes raw takes the nearest size token.
Motion belongs to the seam: no `animation` or keyframes, and no `transition` of `translate`, `transform`, `box-shadow`, `top`, `left`, `width` or `all`. Colour fades on tokens stay.
Resting states render from props; hover, focus and pressed come from interaction. Every focusable part shows the one focus ring, and none sets `outline: none` without a replacement.

`family-css.spec` scans every stylesheet here against these rules, and checks that exactly these seven exist, that nothing but this node sits beside them, and that the styles entry imports each; it holds the surface stylesheets to the same rules.

fs.name: field.css
fs.role: the field frame, TextInput, Select's trigger and its list, and DateField

fs.name: tabs.css
fs.role: Tabs with its stepping row, and PillSwitch with its shared type
